boards.title: Your First Weekend at Rice University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A calm, under-21-safe sequence that starts on campus and opens into nearby Houston green space and art.

cards.entity_name: Rice Welcome Center at Sewall Hall
cards.title: Start with a campus map
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Sewall Hall, Rice campus
cards.notes: Stop at the Welcome Center desk to self-register and pick up a map, then use it to make a first pass through the central campus.
cards.short_summary: Begin with an official map and a low-pressure walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice says visitors may stop by the Welcome Center desk in Sewall Hall between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. Monday through Friday to self-register and pick up a map.
cards.source_title: In-Person Visits | Office of Admission | Rice University
cards.access_notes: The Welcome Center desk hours listed by Rice are 9 a.m.–5 p.m., Monday–Friday; use the official map for a self-guided route.

cards.title: Find Lovett Hall on your first loop
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • Academic Quad
cards.notes: Walk to Lovett Hall and orient yourself on the Academic Quad; Rice identifies the Admission Office inside the building at Door C.
cards.short_summary: Use a signature campus building as an orientation landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice states that its Office of Admission is located inside Lovett Hall and directs visitors to enter through Door C.
cards.source_title: In-Person Visits | Office of Admission | Rice University
cards.access_notes: For an Admission Office visit, Rice directs visitors to Lovett Hall via campus Entrances 1 or 2 from Main Street.

cards.title: Settle into Fondren Library
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon • Academic Quad
cards.notes: Use Fondren as a reset point: enter from the East quad entrance, ask about services, and identify a study spot for the coming week.
cards.short_summary: Turn the library into a familiar academic anchor.
cards.evidence_claim: Fondren Library is on Rice's Academic Quad across from Lovett Hall; Rice directs visitors to enter through its East, quad-facing entrance.
cards.source_title: Getting to Fondren Library | Fondren Library
cards.access_notes: Rice students can use library services; non-Rice public visitors aged 18+ need government ID and may enter only during visitor hours.

cards.title: Pause at Brochstein Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon • Central Quad
cards.notes: Meet a classmate or take a short break at Brochstein Pavilion, then continue through the Central Quad without scheduling anything formal.
cards.short_summary: Make space for an informal first conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice identifies Brochstein Pavilion as a place for small-group meetings, studying, conversations, and campus-community interactions.
cards.access_notes: Use the campus map to locate the pavilion; food and drink purchases, if desired, are separate.

cards.title: See the student-run Coffeehouse
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • Rice Memorial Center
cards.notes: Visit Rice Coffeehouse for a simple meet-up and notice the student-run business inside the student center; buying anything is optional.
cards.short_summary: Add a casual student-run gathering point to your map.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice identifies Rice Coffeehouse as a student-run business, and Rice alumni materials describe it as officially sponsored by the Rice Student Center.
cards.access_notes: Located at the Rice Student Center; confirm current operating hours before going. Purchases are optional but offered.

cards.entity_name: Rice Memorial Center – Ley Student Center
cards.title: Check the student-center event board
cards.subtitle: Friday evening • Rice Memorial Center
cards.notes: Walk through the student center, look for upcoming activities, and choose one open program that fits your first few weeks rather than overfilling the weekend.
cards.short_summary: Locate the campus hub for groups and programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Rice calls the Rice Memorial Center and Ley Student Center a hub for students, with meeting rooms for student groups and spaces for large gatherings.
cards.source_title: Rice Memorial Center - Ley Student Center | Campus Events | Rice University
cards.access_notes: Rice lists regular building hours through 2 a.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday; check the Student Center page for changes.

cards.title: Plan a Saturday gallery visit
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning • Rice campus
cards.notes: Visit the Moody galleries and take time with one exhibition; check the center's current schedule before walking over from the academic core.
cards.short_summary: Build an art stop into an otherwise campus-centered day.
cards.evidence_claim: The Moody Center for the Arts lists free admission and regular Tuesday–Saturday gallery hours of 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.
cards.source_title: Moody Center for the Arts | Rice University
cards.access_notes: Listed gallery hours are Tuesday–Saturday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m; it is closed Sunday, Monday, and holidays.

cards.title: Take an unhurried Hermann Park walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • 6100 Hermann Park Drive
cards.notes: Head to Hermann Park for a daylight walk, choosing a route that feels comfortable and keeping the park's posted closing time in mind.
cards.short_summary: Move the weekend outdoors with a nearby public-park stroll.
cards.evidence_claim: Hermann Park Conservancy lists Hermann Park as open daily from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. and describes it as a free public space.
cards.access_notes: Park hours are listed as 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily. Attraction hours within the park vary and may change with weather or season.

cards.title: Explore the McGovern Centennial Gardens
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • Hermann Park
cards.notes: Walk the themed garden rooms at your own pace, then pause on the central lawn before leaving Hermann Park for the evening.
cards.short_summary: Add a structured garden walk to the park stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Hermann Park Conservancy says the eight-acre McGovern Centennial Gardens contains themed garden rooms arranged around the Centennial Green.
cards.source_title: McGovern Centennial Gardens | Hermann Park Conservancy
cards.access_notes: The Conservancy lists current garden hours as 9 a.m.–6 p.m. daily, with seasonal changes; closed Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.

cards.title: Close with a Sunday Menil visit
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon • 1533 Sul Ross Street
cards.notes: Choose a gallery or green-space walk at the Menil, using the visit page to confirm what is open and leaving time to look slowly.
cards.short_summary: End with free public art beyond the Rice campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Menil Collection states that it is always free and open to all, with Wednesday–Sunday museum hours of 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The Menil lists Wednesday–Sunday hours of 11 a.m.–7 p.m. and says visitors can explore multiple art buildings and green spaces.

warnings: The Twilight Epiphany Skyspace was excluded because its official page says it is currently closed to the public pending a fall 2026 reopening.
